resourceName: Yunnan Shizong IFM (conversion of logged to protected forest) Project
description:
The Yunnan Shizong IFM (conversion of logged to protected  forest) Project (hereafter “the project activity”) is implemented in Shizong County, Qujing City, Yunnan Province of China by Nanpanjiang Forestry Bureau of Yunnan Province, the geo-coordinate of the  project proponent is 103°42'E -104°34'E and 24°20'N - 25°00'N, the total area is 278300hm2, which includes the Improved Forest Management (IFM) of the forests in the conversion of logged to protected forest.
The area of the project activity is 8811.09 ha, including 953 subcompartments spreading over Caiyun Town, Kuishan Town, Xiongbi Town, Zhuji Town, Gaoliang Township, Longqing Township, Wulong Township, Datong Street office, Danfeng Street office, Yangyue Street office of Yunnan Shizong. All these forests are state-owned forests or privately-owned or collective-owned, and have the legal right to forest ownership. The species involved in the project are Pinus armandii Franch, Broadleaf Mix,Quercus,Chinese Fir and Pinus yunnanensis.
Before the implementation of the project activity, the trees are logged based on a valid and verifiable government-approved timber management plan for harvesting the project area. The implementation of the project activity converses the trees to protected forest to reduce the GHG emissions for about 2,737,796 tCO2e in 20 years, the average annual emission reduction is 136,890 tCO2e and Verified Carbon Units with buffer deduction is about 2,573,528 tCO2e in 20 years, and average annual VCUs with buffer deduction is 128,676 tCO2e.
The project activity will contribute to the environment (biodiversity conservation, rocky desertification prevention and soil erosion control), thus contribute to sustainable development.
